items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Zeb, the client of mine. Oh, Zeb Lano.

ctx.x: He didn't? Uh-uh. Well, he didn't have to see to play good anyway. He really could play a little... He could close his eyes and play good. I'm telling you. He didn't have to worry about anything. He didn't have to read. Uh-uh. He didn't have to read. Who was with the... Do you remember the other followers with Kid Oliver? Yeah.

I'll tell you one with William Moshul. You know all of them. I know you know this one. Zeb, the client of mine. Oh, Zeb Lano. Zeb, the one that left you and died. Die up north somewhere. Yeah. Because he left you sick. And when they come to find out, you will get out there.
Listen, I was a lone Frenchman. You too.
